text: Developed features for aircraft flight-data applications using Java, Python, Go, and Vue.js.
Contributed to the development of SOAR, a highly available AWS application for engine-performance analysis and real-time alerts, using Spring Boot and Docker.
Designed an auditable data-export service integrating data across platform versions and supporting up to 700 reports and 500,000 analytic executions per minute.
Troubleshot data issues across engine registration, analytics workflows, AWS services, and corporate networks in a safety-critical application.
Remediated application and Docker-container vulnerabilities identified by Qualys, Prisma Cloud, and SonarQube.
Responded to P1 production outages by triaging incidents, limiting impact, and contributing to root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
Led development of networking and operational features for a cloud-managed 3D-printer fleet, including video streaming, fleet-status monitoring, remote commands, and firmware upgrades.
Delivered a vendor-data reconciliation system for a client with more than $1 billion in annual sales, identifying discrepancies and improving auditor efficiency.
Automated site-health checks, analytics collection, development-environment setup, and server maintenance with PHP, Python, and Bash scripts.
Established logging and security-scanning controls for PCI compliance, using Graylog, OSSEC, Zabbix, and Fail2Ban to strengthen threat detection and response.

Maintained service health for a restaurant-management platform serving more than 1,000 locations by monitoring with Zabbix, performing security scans, and managing AWS auto-scaling rules and server configurations.
Evaluated AWS Lambda, Angular, React, and Firebase through IoT prototypes to demonstrate emerging cloud capabilities to the team.
Contributed to IoT hardware prototypes for managing patients during mass-casualty events; the project placed third at the 2014 IPSO Conference.
Gathered requirements, prepared a technical proposal, implemented features, and wrote unit tests for the company's flagship rating and billing system.
Coordinated unit-equipment movement from Fort Campbell to Kandahar, Afghanistan, for deployment.
Served as a firefighter and lead firefighter, coordinating emergency-response readiness.
Oversaw accountability and inventory of sensitive unit equipment.
